German Benchmarks on Hugging Face
At present, there is a notable scarcity, if not a complete absence, of reliable and true German benchmarks designed to evaluate the capabilities of German Language Models (LLMs). While some efforts have been made to translate English benchmarks into German, these attempts often fall short in terms of precision, accuracy, and context sensitivity, even when employing GPT-4 technology.
